algorithm: Open3D-ML RandLA-Net or KPConv, S3DIS weights (control only)
measurement_scope: label histogram from one forward pass on this synthetic cloud; stud detection, geometry, angle, and paint were not scored

scene.name: s1_2x4_lean1.000_ax-Y
scene.reference_meaning: Stage 0 has no floor. The generator +Z axis is the angle reference. The cloud is not rotated.
scene.description: Phase 1 S1 synthetic dressed stud. Lean 1.000 deg about -Y. Long axis is +Z before the right-hand rotation. Generator gravity is +Z. No floor. The cloud is not rotated.

control.runtime_includes: SemanticSegmentation.run_inference after the checkpoint was loaded
control.color_features: zeros; the generator cloud has no RGB

implementation_short: RandLA-Net S3DIS control. No stud class (ceiling, floor, wall, beam, column, window, door, table, chair, sofa, bookcase, board, clutter). Histogram recorded. No stud box and no paint.

detection.note: Open3D-ML RandLA-Net S3DIS forward pass on this one synthetic stud. Classes: ceiling, floor, wall, beam, column, window, door, table, chair, sofa, bookcase, board, clutter. Stud-named classes: none. RGB features were zeros because the generator cloud has no color. The library's own sampler pads when the subsampled cloud is shorter than 40960 points. predict_labels length 25666 on 25666 input points. Placeholder API labels were zeros and were not treated as ground truth. No stud box was fit and no paint color was assigned. KPConv was not run. S3DIS mIoU was not copied.
